Bash(python3 - <<'EOF'
import re

def strip_inline\(path, add_script=True\):
    with open\(path, 'r', encoding='utf-8'\) as f:
        content = f.read\(\)

    # Remove <style>...</style> block
    content = re.sub\(r'\\n  <style>.*?</style>', '', content, flags=re.DOTALL\)

    # Remove <script>...</script> block and replace with external
    if add_script:
        content = re.sub\(r'\\n  <script>.*?</script>', '\\n  <script src="legal.js"></script>', content, flags=re.DOTALL\)

    with open\(path, 'w', encoding='utf-8'\) as f:
        f.write\(content\)
    print\(f'Done: {path}'\)

strip_inline\('privacy-policy.html'\)
strip_inline\('terms-and-conditions.html'\)
strip_inline\('about-us.html'\)
EOF)
